people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Now for a long time Israel was without the true God, without a teaching priest, and without law.
translations.bsb: For many years Israel has been without the true God, without a priest to instruct them, and without the law.
translations.kjv: Now for a long season Israel hath been without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law.
